source_lines.ordinary_shares: Resolution 96861, item 1.2. The fund issued 5,055,232 ordinary shares at 500 UZS, four for each existing share, by capitalizing retained earnings. September Form 1 lines 410 and 440 confirm 3,159,520,000 UZS of paid-in capital and zero treasury shares. This reconciles to 6,319,040 outstanding shares.
source_lines.ordinary_only: The April meeting allocated 315,952,000 UZS to all shareholders at 250 UZS per share, establishing 1,263,808 existing shares. The issue allocates four ordinary shares per existing share in proportion to number and class. All opening and closing capital is accounted for by these ordinary shares. The March and June filings retain the original 631,904,000 UZS capital. The September filing records the completed issue.
source_lines.weighted_average_shares: The 2026 shareholder resolutions and issue register disclose a single share-count change. Item 1.2 grants four bonus shares per existing share entirely out of retained earnings, with no consideration from shareholders. Form 1 shows zero treasury shares throughout the quarterly balances. The opening 1,263,808 ordinary shares restate by a factor of five to 6,319,040 before the issue, equal to outstanding shares after it. The weighted denominator is consequently 6,319,040 regardless of the placement day.

source_lines.share_intervals: The signed FY2025 audited financial statements, note 11 (PDF page 17), show 3,366,271 fully paid ordinary shares at 1,000 UZS at both year ends. The issuer’s separate statutory annual and interim balance sheets corroborate paid-in capital of 3,366,271 thousand UZS and zero treasury shares.
